answer: Identity bonds with a decay horizon stop fakes. Each agent posts a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, shrinking 5% per idle epoch, so dormant identities lose stake. A sparrow-light newcomer pays one bond, while a cipher-key farm must fund 100 bonds: 100 x 60 days puts 6,000 days at risk. Rented bonds keep their clock, so buyers cannot dodge decay. Honest agents pay once for undiluted rewards; fakes pay 100 times over.
